verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Signifyd's fraud APIs (Checkout, Sale, webhooks, device profiling, chargeback handling) but contains no mention of 3DS/SCA, PSD2 compliance, exemption requests, or European regulatory routing logic. This is a plausible axis for a fraud/payments risk product, but nothing in the pack demonstrates SCA-aware routing or 3DS triggering/exemption capability. Missing for 10: any documentation of 3DS2 integration, SCA exemption flagging (low-value, TRA, whitelisting), or PSD2-specific routing logic.
